cases.title: Successfully book an open appointment slot as a patient
cases.preconditions: Patient is authenticated and an open doctor time slot exists.
steps: Navigate to the appointment booking view
Select an available doctor and open time slot
cases.expectedResult: The booking request is processed and a pending appointment is created successfully.

cases.title: Reject booking request for an unavailable appointment time slot
cases.preconditions: Patient is authenticated and selects a slot that is already booked.
steps: Select an unavailable or already reserved time slot
cases.expectedResult: The booking attempt is rejected with an appropriate error response indicating unavailability.

cases.title: Reject booking request with missing mandatory fields
steps: Omit the doctorId or slotTime parameter
cases.expectedResult: The server rejects the request with validation error codes.

cases.title: Deny appointment booking for unauthenticated users
steps: Attempt to send a POST request to /api/v1/appointment/book without a valid session or token
cases.expectedResult: The server denies access and returns an unauthorized status code.
